description: The native runtime's assertion surface is seven methods, and the protocol reserves the skipped and pending statuses that protocol.py, command.py, and the JUnit writer already consume, but no GDScript can emit them. Add skip_test()/pending_test() with a single mark-and-abort guard, plus nine GUT-core assertions (ordering, range, membership, introspection) that type-check their arguments so a bad call fails the test instead of escalating the run to exit 2. Closes two of the six Known Limitations in ARCHITECTURE.md and unblocks migration roadmap Phase 3.
